description: Country ranking: sort all economies by one World Development Indicator for a year (default: each country's latest value), highest first or lowest first, optionally filtered by World Bank region or income group. Aggregates (World, regions) excluded unless requested. CC BY 4.0. Price: $0.02 USDC per request (fixed; one paid HTTP GET = one charge; x402 exact on Base or MPP on Tempo; 4xx errors are not charged).

income.description: income group substring, e.g. High income, Lower middle

region.description: World Bank region substring, e.g. Latin America, Sub-Saharan

year.description: year; default latest available per country

name: macro_rank
